page.overview:
Who is Talva?

Talva was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also part of the Black Ajah.

She is thin, and wears her golden hair in a bun.

Talva is among the Black sisters who flee the White Tower before the Black Ajah hunters can question them.

While eavesdropping on Egwene al'Vere, Nynaeve al'Meara and Elayne Trakand in Tel'aran'rhiod, Talva unknowingly sets off one of Egwene's wards. She begins to weave Fire at Egwene when the Amyrlin comes to investigate, but is too slow, and Egwene shields her and binds her in flows of Air instead.
